_doc: Per-dataset harvest wiring — the single source of truth binding each catalog dataset to its per-repo extractor and telling tools/assemble_dataset.py how to reassemble the dataset's PRIMARY file(s) from the refreshed contributions/<repo>.jsonl shards. A dataset listed here SELF-REFRESHES: the central catalog-refresh workflow runs its extractor over every estate repo, writes a shard per repo, and the harvest assembler rebuilds the primary file(s) below. Datasets NOT listed here (topic-vocabulary, stemmer-policy) are central-rebuild — see docs/CATALOG-EXTRACTORS.md. merge: 'single-owner' = each id is owned by exactly one repo (concat + dedup by id); 'union' = the same id may recur across repos and its list fields are unioned (used_by/consumers). primary_files maps each committed monolith to an optional id_prefix that routes shard records to it (a shard may feed >1 primary file, e.g. adrs.jsonl + docs.jsonl). contrib_dir defaults to 'contributions'. preserve names top-level files the assembler must NOT touch.
